text:
Market today: Mixed signals. Chip stocks saw a rebound, but the underlying demand for AI infrastructure faces potential headwinds from rising debt costs. This creates uncertainty for your tech/chip heavy book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-79.55%), MUU (-62.95%), and SMCI (-34.46%) are in deep drawdowns. The leveraged ETFs (SOXL, MUU, METU, PLTU, SPAL) are particularly concerning on margin, as drops are amplified.

Watch: Monitor if the chip rebound holds, and keep an eye on data center financing costs.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your significant losses in leveraged positions and protecting any remaining capital.
plays: Trim SOXL to reduce exposure to its -79.55% loss; its 3X leverage and distant stop (200) demand immediate attention.
Consider trimming MUU to cut losses at -62.95%; its 2X leverage and stop (31.6) are not protecting capital effectively.
Trim CRWD to lock in some of its 23.99% gain, especially with many other positions struggling.
